property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos list and a callee that reverts on the called selector, the reference contract always propagates that revert (i.e., the external call fails and transfer reverts or returns false via a caught failure), whereas the mutant with an early unconditional return will return true without performing the external calls and thus will not revert when the callee would have caused a failure.
change_summary: Insert an early unconditional return true before performing any calls, causing the function to return true without invoking calls.
